findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：新興科技公司不受同等監管，可能更快創新、承擔更多風險，使 HOOD 處於競爭劣勢；競爭者包含加密貨幣交易所與科技平台。
findings.excerpt: Some of our competitors, particularly new and emerging technology companies, are not subject to the same regulatory requirements or scrutiny to which we are subject, which could allow them to innovate more quickly or take more risks, placing us at a competitive disadvantage.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：HOOD 自述若跟不上快速演進的 AI 技術，競爭地位與經營結果可能受損。
findings.excerpt: If we fail to keep pace with rapidly evolving AI technological developments, especially in the financial technology sector, our competitive position and business results may suffer.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：金融服務業面臨快速技術變革（證券交易方式與加密貨幣的發展），HOOD 需推出包含事件合約等缺乏經驗的新技術產品。
findings.excerpt: Rapid and significant technological changes continue to confront the financial services industry, including developments in the methods in which securities are traded and developments in cryptocurrencies.

substitute_technology.note: 搜尋摘要提到 2026 年 7 月 Stocktwits 報導：分析師視 Hyperliquid 等加密原生平台為威脅，亦有人認為零售客群是護城河；另有 Q3 2026 10-Q 提及競爭者可能放棄 PFOF。僅為搜尋摘要，未讀原文，列為 clue。

clues.claim: 分析師稱 Hyperliquid 等加密原生去中心化平台為 HOOD 商業模式的潛在威脅；亦有分析師認為零售客群為護城河。
clues.source: Stocktwits 新聞：HOOD Stock Drops Amid Market Sell-Off

clues.claim: 10-Q 指競爭者可能放棄 PFOF，對 HOOD 的 PFOF 安排形成下行壓力。
